verdict.rationale: The evidence documents asynchronous processing with results sent to configured webhooks. Nothing in the pack shows a parameter for attaching custom identifiers or metadata to a transcription job, or echoing such values back in results or webhook payloads. Webhook delivery alone is an adjacent feature and does not satisfy this story.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach my own identifiers or metadata to a job and get them back in results and webhook payloads
